# ADR 0002: Schema-first GraphQL with batch mapping

← [Architecture](../README.md) · [Capstone brief](../../README.md)

- **Status:** Accepted
- **Capstone:** Company financials GraphQL API

## Context

Nested queries over many companies cause N+1 database queries.

## Decision

Write the schema first; resolve nested fields with @BatchMapping so each level costs one query.

## Consequences

Predictable performance. Resolvers must be written for batches.

## Alternatives considered

Per-field resolvers; REST only.
